summary: OWNH covers fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. Ownership is concentrated: Ada Lindqvist holds 54.2% of lines, while inactive owners account for 76.1% at 2026 Q2, a majority since 2023 Q4.
Blank lines represent 20.5% of lines and are attributed to Ada Lindqvist. The next blank-line milestone is projected for 2031 Q4; the line-survival half-life is 2 years and is not projected.

Cross-repository ownership is uneven: 80% of billing-service’s lines were written elsewhere, while 57% of api-gateway’s lines are owned by non-contributors. The methods agree in no repositories, limiting confidence in attribution consistency.

okr.objective: Build a more balanced and consistent ownership profile across repositories.

keyResults.text: Reduce principal-owner concentration from 54.1% at 2026 Q2, after it rose from 51.2% at 2025 Q3.
Lower the inactive-owner share from 76.1% at 2026 Q2, after easing from 77.9% at 2025 Q3, while the majority has persisted since 2023 Q4.
Increase method agreement from a baseline of no repositories.
